gap_note: No standalone Monash one-page blank PDF was publicly mirrored. This form is reconstructed from Ley 2008/2009 published adjective lists for Lab/product UI staging only.
instructions_en: Owner rates each adjective 1-6 for the subject dog. Dimension score uses POMP: 100 * sum / (n_items * 6).
